title: Love's Longing and Description

questions.question: I came to my garden, my sister, my what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 5:1 (ESV): "I came to my garden, my sister, my bride,"

questions.question: Eat, friends, drink, and be drunk with what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 5:1 (ESV): "Eat, friends, drink, and be drunk with love!"

questions.question: I slept, but my heart was what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 5:2 (ESV): "I slept, but my heart was awake."

questions.question: Who was knocking, saying, "Open to me"?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 5:2 (ESV): "A sound! My beloved is knocking. 'Open to me, my sister, my love,'"

questions.question: What is your beloved more than another beloved, O most beautiful among whom?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 5:9 (ESV): "What is your beloved more than another beloved, O most beautiful among women?"

questions.question: My beloved put his hand to the latch, and my heart was thrilled within whom?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 5:4 (ESV): "and my heart was thrilled within me."

questions.question: I arose to open to my beloved, and my hands dripped with what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 5:5 (ESV): "and my hands dripped with myrrh,"

questions.question: I opened to my beloved, but my beloved had turned and was what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 5:6 (ESV): "I opened to my beloved, but my beloved had turned and gone."

questions.question: The watchmen found me as they went about in the city; they beat me, they bruised me, they took away my what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 5:7 (ESV): "they took away my veil, those watchmen of the walls."

questions.question: My beloved is radiant and ruddy, distinguished among how many?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 5:10 (ESV): "distinguished among ten thousand."

questions.question: His head is the finest gold; his locks are wavy, black as a what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 5:11 (ESV): "his locks are wavy, black as a raven."

questions.question: His arms are rods of gold, set with what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 5:14 (ESV): "His arms are rods of gold, set with jewels."

questions.question: His body is polished ivory, bedecked with what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 5:14 (ESV): "his body is polished ivory, bedecked with sapphires."

questions.question: His legs are alabaster columns, set on bases of what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 5:15 (ESV): "His legs are alabaster columns, set on bases of gold."

questions.question: His mouth is most sweet, and he is altogether what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 5:16 (ESV): "His mouth is most sweet, and he is altogether desirable."

key_verse_text: His mouth is most sweet, and he is altogether desirable. This is my beloved and this is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.
